verdict.rationale: Next.js is an open-source React framework that the user deploys themselves; it is not a hosted service that stores customer data, so a vendor-controlled storage region or residency choice is a category error for this product type. Self-hosting (next-js-docs-16) only decides where the user's own app runs. That is a deployment and user-side arrangement, not a data-residency feature of the framework, and nothing in the evidence shows the framework itself offering storage-region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
